en.headline: Work-week outlook: sunny periods and isolated showers, hotter midweek
en.dek: The Observatory expects mainly fine weather with sunny intervals early in the week before the northeast monsoon strengthens later, bringing cooler nights and a chance of showers.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory’s nine-day forecast issued on Sunday points to a gradual shift from light winds and residual showers to clearer conditions early in the coming work week.

Monday is expected to remain mainly cloudy with a few showers and sunny intervals, temperatures ranging from 27 to 32 degrees. Tuesday should turn mainly fine and very hot, with maximum temperatures around 33 degrees under light east to northeast winds.

From Wednesday the northeast monsoon is forecast to affect the region. Winds will freshen to force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore, while sunny periods continue with a few showers. Temperatures will ease slightly to the upper 20s at night and around 31 degrees by day.

Thursday and Friday look similar, with north to northeast winds force 4 to 5 and sunny periods. A broad area of low pressure may develop over the central South China Sea later in the week, raising the chance of more unsettled weather towards the weekend. Residents are advised to check the latest forecasts as conditions can change.

zh.headline: 下周天氣展望：初段有陽光 中後期東北季候風增強
zh.dek: 天文台預期下周初大致天晴間中有驟雨，其後東北季候風影響，風勢增強，氣溫稍降，周末或轉為較不穩定。
body: 香港天文台周日發出的九天天氣預報顯示，未來數日廣東沿岸風勢仍然微弱，一道雲帶會為華南帶來幾陣驟雨，其後雲帶逐漸減弱，華南天氣轉為大致天晴。
周一大致多雲，有一兩陣驟雨，日間部分時間有陽光，氣溫約27至32度。周二大致天晴，日間酷熱，最高氣溫約33度，吹微弱至和緩東至東北風。
周三起東北季候風預料影響華南，吹東至東北風四級，離岸間中五級，有陽光及幾陣驟雨，氣溫稍為下降。周四及周五風勢維持，日間有陽光，間中有驟雨。
周末期間南海中部可能逐漸發展一個廣闊低壓區，為該區帶來較不穩定天氣。市民請留意最新天氣消息。
